name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS)
ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
application_cycle_note: Annual cycle typically opens on NSP between July and September; applications usually close around November-December. Academic deadlines are set yearly by the Ministry of Education.
benefit_details: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of ₹12,000 per annum at Graduation level for first 3 years of College and University courses, and ₹20,000 per annum at Post-Graduation level. For 5-year integrated courses, ₹20,000/yr is paid in 4th & 5th year.

other_conditions: Must be above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the respective Board of Examination in Class XII (10+2).
Must be pursuing regular full-time degree courses from colleges/institutions recognized by AICTE, UGC, or respective regulatory bodies.
Students pursuing correspondence, distance mode, or diploma courses are not eligible.
Must not be in receipt of any other scholarship or fee reimbursement from Central or State Government.

required_documents: Class 12th Board Marksheet showing roll number and marks
Aadhaar Card (linked to bank account)
Valid Annual Family Income Certificate issued by competent Revenue Authority (Tehsildar/SDM)
College Bonafide Student Certificate with roll number & enrollment details
College Fee Receipt for the current academic year
Active Bank Passbook/Statement showing IFSC and Account Number (Aadhaar Seeded)
Caste / Category Certificate (if applying under SC/ST/OBC quota)
verification_checklist: Check that your Class 12 board percentile is listed in the state board's top 20th percentile cut-off list on NSP.
Ensure family annual income certificate is within validity period (< ₹4,50,000).
Verify your bank account is Aadhaar seeded (NPCI mapped) to receive Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
Verify you are not claiming dual scholarship benefits from any other state or central scheme.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Degree)
ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
application_cycle_note: Opens annually on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) around August-September. Selection is based on merit in qualifying examination.
benefit_amount_display: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study
benefit_details: Lump sum amount of ₹50,000 per annum credited directly to student bank account for every year of study towards college fees, purchase of computer, stationery, books, and equipment.

other_conditions: Strictly for girl students admitted to 1st year of Degree Level course or 2nd year of Degree level course through lateral entry.
Institution must be AICTE approved.
Maximum two girls per family are eligible.
Selection is based solely on merit in the qualifying exam (Class 12th / Diploma) for admission to AICTE approved technical institution.

required_documents: Class 10th and 12th Marksheets
Centralized Admission Process (CAP) allotment letter for technical degree
Current Academic Year College Tuition Fee Receipt
Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar/competent authority (gross income <= ₹8 Lakh)
Aadhaar Card
Bank Account details (Bank Passbook showing student's name, IFSC, Account number)
Declaration by parents confirming that they have not more than two eligible girl applicants
verification_checklist: Confirm college has active AICTE approval for your course branch for the current academic year.
Verify family income certificate is current and below ₹8,00,000.
Check that student bank account is strictly in applicant's sole name (not joint) and NPCI mapped.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students (Technical Degree)
ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
application_cycle_note: Announced each academic session on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).
benefit_amount_display: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study
benefit_details: ₹50,000 per annum towards payment of college fees, purchase of computer, assistive devices, books, and study aids.

other_conditions: Specially-abled student having disability not less than 40% certified by competent medical authority.
Admitted to 1st year of Degree level course or 2nd year through lateral entry in an AICTE approved institution.
All eligible specially-abled candidates meeting criteria are awarded the scholarship.

required_documents: Valid Disability Certificate issued by Competent Medical Authority (UDID Card / Government Medical Board)
Class 10th and 12th Marksheets
College Admission Allotment Letter in AICTE approved college
Current Year Fee Receipt
Annual Family Income Certificate (< ₹8 Lakh)
Aadhaar Card
Student Bank Passbook with NPCI Aadhaar seeding
verification_checklist: Ensure disability percentage is clearly stated as 40% or more on official UDID card or medical board certificate.
Verify college course is recognized under AICTE approval.
Check income certificate validity.

name: Post-Matric Scholarships Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students (PMS-SC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India
application_cycle_note: Processed via NSP or designated State scholarship portals according to state adoption guidelines. Typically active from July to December.
benefit_amount_display: 100% Compulsory Fee Waiver + up to ₹13,500/yr Maintenance Allowance
benefit_details: Full non-refundable compulsory course fee coverage (tuition, library, exam fees) plus annual maintenance allowance ranging from ₹2,500 to ₹13,500 depending on course classification (Group 1 to Group 4) and hosteller/day scholar status.

other_conditions: Belongs to Scheduled Caste (SC) community.
Pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary courses in recognized institutions.
Total family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum.
Students enrolled in same stage of education in different subject (e.g. B.Com after B.A.) are not eligible.

required_documents: Official Caste / Community Certificate issued by designated Revenue Authority (SDM/Tehsildar)
Income Certificate of parents from competent revenue authority (<= ₹2.5 Lakh)
Previous Year Qualifying Marksheet
Current Year College Fee Receipt and Bonafide Certificate
Aadhaar Card
Hostel Warden Certificate (if claiming hosteller maintenance allowance)
Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar
verification_checklist: Ensure caste certificate barcode / number is verifiable on state revenue portal.
Check income certificate is dated within the current financial year.
Verify college fee receipt specifies non-refundable components clearly.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Tribe Students (PMS-ST)
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Govt. of India
application_cycle_note: Operated through the National Scholarship Portal and respective state tribal welfare departments.
benefit_amount_display: Full Tuition Fee Waiver + Monthly Maintenance Allowance
benefit_details: Comprehensive assistance covering mandatory college tuition fees, study tour charges, thesis typing charges, and monthly maintenance allowance paid directly via DBT.

other_conditions: Candidate must belong to a recognized Scheduled Tribe (ST).
Enrolled in post-matric studies at recognized universities, colleges, or higher secondary schools.
Total family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum.

required_documents: Valid ST Caste Certificate issued by Sub-Divisional Officer / Magistrate
Family Income Certificate issued by competent authority (< ₹2,50,000)
Marksheet of previous qualifying exam
College Bonafide Certificate and Admission Letter
Current year fee breakdown receipt
Aadhaar Card and Aadhaar-seeded Bank Passbook
verification_checklist: Ensure ST certificate is issued in applicant's name with valid digital signature/seal.
Confirm college institute code is registered under NSP / State Tribal Department.
Check income certificate is not older than allowed limit by state.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Other Backward Classes (OBC) Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India
application_cycle_note: Implemented through State Governments and UT Administrations via NSP or State Scholarship Portals.
benefit_amount_display: Reimbursement of Compulsory Fees + Maintenance Allowance
benefit_details: Reimbursement of tuition and compulsory non-refundable fees, plus maintenance allowance of up to ₹10,000/year based on course category.

other_conditions: Belongs to Other Backward Classes (OBC) in the Central or State list.
Candidate must belong to Non-Creamy Layer (NCL).
Family income ceiling of ₹2,50,000 per annum.
Only two boys of the same parents are eligible (this restriction does not apply to girls).

required_documents: OBC Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
Annual Family Income Certificate (<= ₹2.5 Lakh)
Qualifying Examination Marksheet
College Enrollment / Bonafide Certificate
Fee Receipt for the ongoing academic session
Aadhaar Card and Bank Account Statement
verification_checklist: Verify Non-Creamy Layer certificate is valid for the current financial year.
Ensure course is recognized by state or central regulatory authority.
Check income certificate matches details in NCL certificate.

name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region (NER)
ministry: University Grants Commission (UGC), Ministry of Education
application_cycle_note: Annual slot allocation of 10,000 fresh scholarships on NSP. Applications typically close between October and December.
benefit_details: Direct monthly stipend transferred through DBT: ₹5,400 per month for general degree courses (approx ₹64,800/yr), or ₹7,800 per month for technical, professional, medical, and paramedical courses (approx ₹93,600/yr).

other_conditions: Must have domicile of any North Eastern State (Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura).
Must have passed Class XII or equivalent examination from a school situated in the NER recognized by CBSE, ICSE, or State boards.
Must have secured admission in the 1st year of any general degree or professional degree course in recognized universities/colleges (UGC Section 2(f) and 12(B)).
Dual scholarship under Central schemes is prohibited.

required_documents: Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC) / Domicile Certificate of North Eastern State
Class 12th Board Marksheet and Pass Certificate from NER School
Annual Family Income Certificate issued by competent authority (< ₹4.5 Lakh)
College Admission Allotment Letter and Bonafide Certificate
Fee Receipt for 1st Year UG
Aadhaar Card and Aadhaar-linked Bank Account Passbook
verification_checklist: Ensure your Domicile/PRC certificate is specifically from one of the 8 North Eastern states.
Confirm that Class 12th examination was passed from a school physically located within NER.
Check that your college is recognized under UGC Act (Section 2f/12B) or AICTE/MCI.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Govt. of India
application_cycle_note: Invited annually through the National Scholarship Portal. Renewal and fresh windows operate in the second half of the calendar year.
benefit_amount_display: Admission & Course Fee + up to ₹1,200/month Maintenance Allowance
benefit_details: Actual admission and tuition fee reimbursement (subject to ceiling) plus monthly maintenance allowance for 10 months in an academic year (₹570 to ₹1,200/month depending on course level and hosteller status). 30% of scholarships are earmarked for female students.

other_conditions: Belongs to one of the notified minority communities: Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, or Parsi.
Secured not less than 50% marks or equivalent grade in the previous final examination.
Annual income of parents/guardians from all sources does not exceed ₹2,00,000.
30% scholarship quota is specifically earmarked for girl students.

required_documents: Self-declaration / Community Certificate of belonging to Minority Community
Marksheet of previous final examination showing >= 50% marks
Annual Family Income Certificate issued by authorized revenue officer (<= ₹2 Lakh)
Fee Receipt of current academic course
Institute Bonafide Certificate
Aadhaar Card and Bank Passbook (NPCI mapped)
verification_checklist: Verify previous examination score meets the mandatory 50.0% cutoff.
Check income certificate ceiling of ₹2,00,000.
Ensure self-declaration or religious community certificate is properly signed and uploaded.

name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme
ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
application_cycle_note: Operated through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). 2,000 scholarships awarded annually.
benefit_amount_display: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study
benefit_details: ₹50,000 per annum for each year of study towards college fees, hostel expenses, purchase of books, equipment, and learning materials.

other_conditions: Candidate must be either: (a) Orphan, or (b) Either or both parents died due to COVID-19, or (c) Wards of Armed Forces and Central Paramilitary Forces martyred in action (Shaheed).
Must be admitted to an AICTE approved technical institution for Degree or Diploma course.
Family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000 per annum.

required_documents: Death certificate of parents or Shaheed / Martyrdom certificate from Armed Forces authority
Orphan certificate issued by competent district social welfare / revenue authority (if applicable)
Income Certificate (< ₹8 Lakh per annum)
Class 10th and 12th / Diploma Marksheet
Admission confirmation letter in AICTE approved college
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Account details
verification_checklist: Ensure parent death / martyr certificate is issued by recognized government or military authority.
Verify college has active AICTE affiliation for the course.
Confirm student bank account is active and seeded with Aadhaar.

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC)
ministry: Higher and Technical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra
application_cycle_note: Portal is managed by Government of Maharashtra. Usually opens in August and has multiple extension phases through January/February.
benefit_details: 50% concession on tuition fees and exam fees for students admitted through CAP round in Government, Aided, and Unaided Private professional and non-professional higher education colleges in Maharashtra.

other_conditions: Candidate must be a Domicile of Maharashtra State.
Admission must be taken through Centralized Admission Process (CAP) round.
Gross annual family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000 per annum (for income up to ₹2.5L 50% waiver; for ₹2.5L to ₹8L 50% tuition waiver).
Only up to 2 beneficiaries per family for professional courses.
Minimum 50% attendance required in previous semester/year.

required_documents: Domicile Certificate of Maharashtra State issued by Tehsildar/SDO
Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar (strictly for the current financial year, <= ₹8 Lakh)
CAP Allotment Letter / Merit list confirmation letter
Class 10th, 12th, or previous semester marksheet
Current Year College Fee Receipt
Ration Card or Family Declaration Affidavit (specifying number of children)
Aadhaar Card and Bank Account seeded with NPCI
verification_checklist: Check that your Domicile certificate mentions 'State of Maharashtra'.
Confirm admission was through government CAP round (Management/NRI quota admissions are not eligible).
Ensure Tahsildar income certificate is currently valid.

name: Uttar Pradesh Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (Dashmottar)
ministry: Social Welfare / Backward Classes / Minority Department, Govt. of Uttar Pradesh
application_cycle_note: Administered directly by UP Social Welfare Department. Application windows typically run July-November each year with phased disbursement.
benefit_amount_display: Non-Refundable Fee Reimbursement + Monthly Maintenance Allowance
benefit_details: Full or partial reimbursement of verified non-refundable tuition and institutional fees plus monthly maintenance stipend paid directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.

other_conditions: Candidate must be a bona fide resident/domicile of Uttar Pradesh.
Annual family income cap: ₹2,00,000 for General/OBC/Minority; ₹2,50,000 for SC/ST students.
Student must be enrolled in a recognized college/institution in Uttar Pradesh.
Attendance must be at least 75% as verified by the institute on the UP portal.

required_documents: UP Domicile / Niwas Praman Patra
Income Certificate (Aay Praman Patra) verifiable online through e-District UP
Caste Certificate (Jati Praman Patra) if applicable, verified via e-District UP
High School (10th) & Intermediate (12th) Marksheet
College Enrollment / Registration Number and Current Year Fee Receipt
Aadhaar Card with mobile linkage for DigiLocker authentication
Aadhaar-seeded Bank Passbook
verification_checklist: Ensure your Income and Caste certificates are online-verifiable on edistrict.up.gov.in.
Verify that your Aadhaar card name and date of birth match exactly with your High School marksheet.
Confirm college has verified and forwarded your digital application before state deadline.

name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric Scheme
ministry: Social Welfare / Backward Classes / Tribal Welfare Departments, Govt. of Karnataka
application_cycle_note: Invited annually through Karnataka SSP portal. Registration requires Kutumba ID or Aadhaar authentication.
benefit_amount_display: Course Fee Reimbursement + Hostel / Maintenance Stipend
benefit_details: Tuition and exam fee reimbursement credited to college or student account, plus food and hostel maintenance allowance (up to ₹1,500/month) for eligible day scholars and hostellers.

other_conditions: Candidate must be a permanent resident of Karnataka State.
Enrolled in post-matric courses in recognized Karnataka educational institutions.
Family income cap: ₹2,50,000 for SC/ST; ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,50,000 for Category 1/OBC depending on specific backward class sub-category.
Valid Kutumba (Family) ID and e-Attestation of documents are mandatory.

required_documents: Karnataka RD Income and Caste Certificate (RD Number verifiable on Nadakacheri portal)
Karnataka Domicile Certificate / Study Certificate from Karnataka institutions (minimum 7 years)
Student Aadhaar Card and Kutumba Family ID
Current Year College Fee Receipt
Previous Semester / Year Marksheet
Bank Account details seeded with NPCI
verification_checklist: Verify RD number of Caste and Income certificate on Nadakacheri portal.
Complete e-Attestation of study certificate and marksheets via SSP e-attestation officer.
Check Kutumba family portal linking for student profile.
